name: Taxes
description: Review transportation billing and tax summary information, revenue and status totals, detailed trip rows, and export or print the report.

tasks.title: Review the revenue summary
tasks.summary: Use Revenue Summary to review billable totals including completed, cancelled, and No Show amounts.
steps: Check cancelled revenue and cancellation fees when present.
Review No Show billable amounts when present.

tasks.title: Review trip totals
tasks.summary: Use Trip Summary to review Total Trips, Individual Trips, Shared Trips, and Shared Passengers.

tasks.title: Review status totals
tasks.summary: Use Status Summary to review Completed, Cancelled, and No Show trip counts.

tasks.title: Review detailed trip rows
tasks.summary: Use the report table to inspect individual trip billing rows.
steps: Review Trip Number, service/type, trip date, status, and billing values.

tasks.title: Export the tax report to CSV
tasks.summary: Use Export CSV for spreadsheet or accounting review.
steps: Open the exported file and verify the report.
keywords: export the tax report to csv

tasks.title: Print the tax report
tasks.summary: Use Print Report for a printable version.
steps: Print or save as PDF using the browser.
